task: Native disclosure and popup motion integration in actual Vue callers
scope: 94 native details inventoried; editor-only authored Vue components; shared UiPropertySection exact-element owner is excluded. No motion system, CSS, tests, docs, build, browser, game, physics, network or project schema edits.

actualControllerContract.logicalState: dataset/summary aria-expanded changes immediately; native open remains true during outgoing presentation; outgoing bodies become inert immediately; native open=false only when exit settles
actualControllerContract.popupSurfaces: All direct HTMLElement children except summary; no details height or popup overflow animation

consequencesChecked: Existing open/v-if/ref/action/value bindings and scripts are preserved by AST-offset edits and reversible template/script comparisons.
VisualGraphEditor graph-more is outside graph-transform; only its direct absolute header menu uses popup presence, with node/port/wire/pointer mathematics unchanged.
Object Ownership runtime refresh follows the immediate logical intent; outgoing provenance content remains mounted only until final native close.
Nested details keep independent disclosure owners; static ancestors with their own panel/dialog transitions do not suppress their children.
Shared UiPropertySection exact-element controller is not marked twice.
notYetVerified: Parent will type-check, rebuild and exercise public-input interruption/keyboard/focus/project-switch cleanup in the real GUI.
Object Ownership now calls nextTick refreshDisclosure to remeasure the shared latest target after lazy mounting; public-input first-open/reversal validation remains pending.
No claim of visually observed animation smoothness is made by this source-only migration.

exclusions.reason: Shared UiPropertySection owns this exact native element; no duplicate caller marker.
